name: Sticky Stacking Card Deck with Scale Decay & Viewport Pinning
description: Transforms a sequence of project cards into an overlapping physical card deck. Each card pins to a sticky viewport threshold while subsequent cards stack over it, applying a subtle scale reduction (targetScale = 1 - (total - 1 - i) * 0.03) to create physical depth without 3D meshes.
designPhilosophy: Transforming a linear sequence of portfolio projects into an overlapping physical card deck. Rather than scrolling projects off-screen into void, each card pins to a sticky viewport threshold while subsequent cards stack over it, applying a subtle scale reduction to create physical depth and visual hierarchy without complex 3D meshes.
appropriateUseCases: Creative portfolio project showcases and case study indexes
Pricing tiers and multi-step feature walkthroughs
Product specifications and layered narrative storytelling
implementationApproach: 1. Sticky Container Architecture: Place each card inside an h-[85vh] container with position: sticky and top offset: top: calc(6rem + index * 28px). 2. Scale Decay Formula: Bind scale to scroll progress through each card's container using targetScale = 1 - (totalCards - 1 - index) * 0.03. As card n+1 scrolls in, card n scales down smoothly to targetScale. 3. Architectural Overlap: Cards feature pronounced border-radius (rounded-[40px] to rounded-[60px]) and 1px to 2px hairline borders, ensuring stacked card headers remain distinct. 4. Negative Section Overlap: Next section uses negative margin (-mt-14) to pull over the final stacked card seamlessly.
performanceConsiderations: Transform and scale animations are hardware-accelerated. Uses passive scroll observation and isolates each card's layout boundary to prevent scroll jank.
accessibilityRequirements: When prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, disables the sticky scale decay and presents cards in a standard natural vertical block flow with clear heading landmarks.
